a: You can only specify Digimon that can't attack or block at the time this card’s effect is activated.
q: I use this card, but my opponent has no Digimon without digivolution cards in play, so I can't specify any Digimon that can't attack or block.
If my opponent later plays a Digimon without digivolution cards to their battle area, can I make that Digimon unable to attack or block?

Card Q&A.a: When the effect of this card is activated on the opponent's turn, it lasts until the end of that turn.
Card Q&A.q: If this card's effect is activated on the opponent's turn, how long does the effect last?

Effect: [Main] Trash the bottom digivolution card of all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, up to 3 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until the end of your opponent's next turn.
